newsitem.title: USA: More firefighters on way to contain Alaska blaze.
newsitem.headline: More firefighters on way to contain Alaska blaze.

text.p: Three fresh crews were preparing to join the firefighters working to contain a 400,000-acre blaze burning near three Athabaskan Indian villages about 250 miles west of here, officials said Friday.

About 220 residents of Sleetmute, Red Devil and Stony River were preparing for possible evacuation, said Andy Williams, a spokesman for the Alaska Interagency Coordination Centre, the federal and state office responsible for Alaska brush fire management.
So far this year, 562 fires in Alaska have burned 1.14 million acres, the centre said.
